name: Two-Person Crossover
description: A businessman and businesswoman cross three times; swap their prompts to test binding.
style_prompt: High-contrast cinematic street photography with crisp afternoon sunlight, sharp shadows, steady eye-level camera framing, realistic detail, and natural colors.
scene_prompt: A modern glass office plaza with reflective skyscraper windows and polished concrete, where exactly two businesspeople walk repeatedly along opposing paths and cross one another three times.

objects.name: Businessman
objects.prompt: A businessman wearing a tailored charcoal-gray three-piece wool suit, a white dress shirt, polished black leather shoes, and carrying a slim dark leather briefcase.

objects.name: Businesswoman
objects.prompt: A businesswoman wearing a flowing scarlet-red silk dress and matching red high-heeled shoes, with shoulder-length blonde hair and a poised confident stride.
